reasons: The claimed deviation is correct: Section 13 binds the Customer as well as the Contractor, so the preferred 'no non-solicit on Customer' position is not met, and the clause lacks the general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-out required by the fallback.

The redline is additive only — the original mutual, 12-month, Services-personnel-limited solicitation restraint is untouched and a standard two-part carve-out sentence (general advertisements/non-targeted recruiting and unsolicited approaches) is appended, which is the smallest edit that reaches the fallback under the redline guidance.

No no-hire language exists ('solicit for hire' is a solicitation restraint), so nothing needed deletion; duration (one (1) year) and scope (personnel with direct involvement with the Services) already conform to the fallback and are well inside the 24-month walk-away limit.

Failed deterministic checks are not substantive: the duration regex missed the spelled-out 'one (1) year' (= 12 months), and the 0.830 changed-character ratio reflects the appended carve-out sentence rather than any rewrite or deletion of negotiated text.
Comment is accurate, on-tone, correctly prefixed, and cites the playbook fallback position without overstating the issue.
